quest.title: The Stars Inscribe the Year's Wishes
quest.description: The unexpected fireworks theft has caused Keqing to be even busier.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

chapter.num: Fleeting Colors in Flight: Part III
chapter.title: The Stars Inscribe the Year's Wishes

talks.objective: Wait until the appointed time (08:00 – 12:00 the next day)

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Rest assured, all is quiet here in Qingce Village. Chongyun is guarding the outside, and I'm guarding the inside. Not a problem in sight.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Good. I've made some progress in my investigation as well.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Oh? What are you planning? Is it time to strike?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's go!

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Traveler, Paimon, you are just in time.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I looked everywhere and I found some clues regarding the Treasure Hoarders. Besides wagon tracks, I also came across bits and pieces of fireworks packaging scattered on the road.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Following those clues, I was able to finally locate the missing fireworks. But there was no sign of Treasure Hoarders.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Hmm, did they run away?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: No, I think they might be just overly careless. I seem to have found the location where they've been stashing all their stolen goods. They must have thought it was well-hidden and deemed it unnecessary to post any guards.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: The amount of fireworks they've amassed there is astonishing. Not only did they steal the ones in Qingce Village but also from other locations, too. They've gathered all the stolen goods there.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I've asked the Millelith on guard at Qingce Village to report this to the Ministry of Civil Affairs. They will organize a search around that warehouse.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now that the Millelith is involved, you don't need to handle this yourself anymore!

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: The Treasure Hoarders are notoriously cunning, and they may even have lookouts. If they notice anything suspicious, they will move the fireworks and our single lead will be lost. I have to keep an eye on the situation.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, you're not really thinking that you can take all of them yourself, are you?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: No, I am not that reckless. I just want to investigate the case thoroughly.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: But now that I have your help, the idea is feasible...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you really are considering it!

choices.text: (We can't let Keqing try to handle this on her own.)

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Okay, then there's no time to lose. Let's go.

choices.text: They're just Treasure Hoarders, we can take 'em.

talks.objective: Go to the place that Keqing spoke of

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Though they are merely a group of irksome bandits, please, exercise caution.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: These Treasure Hoarders must have returned to check on the stolen fireworks.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Please hide yourselves. Let's wait and see what happens.

dialogues.speaker: Xiuyong
dialogues.text: Hey Boss, you think we have enough fireworks now?

dialogues.speaker: Xingxiu
dialogues.text: Hah! Are you kidding? This ain't nowhere near enough!

dialogues.speaker: Xiuyong
dialogues.text: Uh, but Boss, if we want more fireworks, we'll have to steal 'em in the city! Ain't gonna be easy...

dialogues.speaker: Xingxiu
dialogues.text: Hmm... You got a point. Alright, then we steal those things that make a real loud bang but don't light up real pretty... What do they call 'em? Ah yeah, firecrackers! Those'll do the job!

dialogues.speaker: Xingxiu
dialogues.text: All we need to do is make some real ruckus.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxiu
dialogues.text: As long as we distract the Millelith, the other hoarders can do their end of the job. You get it?

dialogues.speaker: Xiuyong
dialogues.text: Got it, Boss! Hehe, I gotta hand it to ya, we're gonna hit the jackpot this time!

dialogues.speaker: Xiuyong
dialogues.text: But, uh Boss... All our boys are out scouting around. Don't ya think we need a few more to guard the stash?

dialogues.speaker: Xingxiu
dialogues.text: Hey, don't worry about it. The Millelith are swamped with Lantern Rite, they won't have time to come out here. Alright, move it boys! Just a few more batches and we'll be...

dialogues.speaker: Junming
dialogues.text: Uh-oh! Hey, Boss! We've got trouble!

dialogues.speaker: Xingxiu
dialogues.text: Huh!? What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Junming
dialogues.text: The jig is up, Boss! Th—The Millelith are coming! And it seems they've already caught our scouts!

dialogues.speaker: Junming
dialogues.text: If one of the boys hadn't set off a firework to warn us, we would've been completely blindsided! Boss, let's run!

dialogues.speaker: Xingxiu
dialogues.text: But how did the Millelith find out about us? And so quickly too!?

dialogues.speaker: Xingxiu
dialogues.text: Arg, fine! Leave the fireworks and let's split! They won't be catching us!

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: It's time to make our move! Ready?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm ready!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Alright, so you want to do this the hard way.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxiu
dialogues.text: W—We surrender, Yuheng.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Now, I want some answers. What were you planning to do with the stockpile of fireworks?

dialogues.speaker: Xingxiu
dialogues.text: Uh, w—we just...

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Tell the truth and I might go easy on you.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxiu
dialogues.text: We... *sigh* Fine.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxiu
dialogues.text: We were gonna smuggle these fireworks into the city and ignite them during the Lantern Rite's opening ceremony.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxiu
dialogues.text: The fireworks are really bright and loud, and would definitely raise some havoc. We were gonna rob the city while everyone's distracted by the explosions.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxiu
dialogues.text: But, uh... We didn't seem to have enough fireworks, so...

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Oh? So you mean you had more than one group of thieves stealing fireworks?

dialogues.speaker: Xingxiu
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's right... originally I had all the hoarders out stealing fireworks, but then one of them got caught by the Feiyun Commerce Guild and was arrested.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxiu
dialogues.text: I really didn't get it! Why did the Feiyun Commerce Guild get involved? We were only stealing from the government...

dialogues.speaker: Xingxiu
dialogues.text: No, what I meant is, uh... Well, I was worried that the guy who got arrested would rat us out.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxiu
dialogues.text: If word got out, we could lose everything. So I ordered most of our boys to come back.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxiu
dialogues.text: Who woulda guessed we'd end up runnin' into you like that...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Didn't one of you just say that the Millelith were coming, too?

dialogues.speaker: Junming
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's right... I wonder how the Millelith found out we had dispatched scouts.

dialogues.speaker: Junming
dialogues.text: They somehow captured almost all of them... If someone hadn't alerted us, we would all have been caught.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, you did get caught.

dialogues.speaker: Junming
dialogues.text: Well... uh, yeah...

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: It appears that the Millelith managed to get the captured Treasure Hoarder to talk.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: There may still be other Treasure Hoarders in the area. We should head elsewhere, just to be safe.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Traveler, please escort the Treasure Hoarders back to Qingce Village and hand them over to the Millelith stationed there.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: I'll be there once I am finished inspecting this place.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Understood, please be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Yes, you too. I'll see you in Qingce Village.

dialogues.speaker: Pengyi
dialogues.text: *sigh* This is the last batch of fireworks that I can get. Please ensure that there will be no further problems.

dialogues.speaker: Jingcheng
dialogues.text: Don't worry, the Yuheng will be taking care of this personally. And with us on guard, I assure you it'll be safe.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Yes, indeed. Oh? It appears the Traveler has returned.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: And with two others, no doubt.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They're the thieves who stole the fireworks.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell everyone how the thieves were caught...

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: It's definitely dangerous to infiltrate an enemy area like that. If only I was there to fight alongside you...

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Come now, we both know the Traveler is most capable. Hehe, but who would've known we performed such a noble deed... We had arrested the Treasure Hoarder earlier by mere happenstance.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! Talk about a coincidence!

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: It seems that justice always finds its way into the world. It is in fateful moments that miracles are born.

dialogues.speaker: Pengyi
dialogues.text: So it was you! You horrible brutes are the ones who stole the fireworks!? Just the sight of you two makes my blood boil...

dialogues.speaker: Jingcheng
dialogues.text: Please, calm down. I doubt they'll be causing any more trouble now that they're in custody. Thank you very much, Traveler. But may I ask, why has Lady Keqing not returned with you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Lady Keqing was worried there'd be more Treasure Hoarders lurking about. She wanted to conduct a full search of the area.

dialogues.speaker: Jingcheng
dialogues.text: Oh, I see... Yes, Lady Keqing is quite thorough. A squad of Millelith came by just now. I believe they were sent by the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Jingcheng
dialogues.text: I also heard that most of the fleeing Treasure Hoarders have already been apprehended, hopefully that will be the end of this matter.

dialogues.speaker: Jingcheng
dialogues.text: Anyway, you may leave these Treasure Hoarders to us. I will escort them back to the city and make sure they stand trial with the others.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: And thus our chapter has finally reached its timely conclusion. I am partial to fireworks myself, but I'm afraid we must also be leaving now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Why the hurry to get back to the Feiyun Commerce Guild? Don't tell us you have work to do, too...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you also busy these days, Xingqiu?

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Inevitably, affairs do become busier around festive seasons. But no need to worry, we have many attendants to assist us... And there's always Chongyun, too.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Huh? You mean you're assigning more work to me?

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: 'Tis only my duty as your dearest friend. Work before play, as they say. I am sure you understand.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Oh alright, I suppose...

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: As the saying goes, "Many hands make light work." As long as work is assigned to the right people, everything will proceed without a hitch.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: If you ask me, I think speaking eloquently is just a guise for assigning work to everybody else.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Alright, alright. I shall treat you to a meal after the work is done!

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Farewell, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Chongyun and Xingqiu leave with others from the guild.

dialogues.speaker: Pengyi
dialogues.text: By the way, do you know when Lady Keqing will be back, Traveler?

dialogues.speaker: Pengyi
dialogues.text: There are not many fireworks in the second batch that I brought, so I'm worried that we can't achieve the show's desired effect. I was hoping we could somehow retrieve the stolen fireworks.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, did you hear that explosion!? Maybe it was fireworks? *gasp* Or maybe more Treasure Hoarders!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It came from Keqing's location!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no, maybe she ran into trouble! Let's go and help her!

talks.objective: Follow the sound to its source

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Oops, what did I do?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Keqing!

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Huh? What Treasure Hoarders?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We heard an explosion and thought it might be Treasure Hoarders sending signals to one another again.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Ah, I see. Sorry, that's not the case. I saw a few sticks of fireworks on the ground, so I fiddled with them and...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Sure enough, it seems I accidentally lit the fuse. Before I could react, the fireworks were... *ahem* already up in the air.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Oh, I see.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, no enemies? Well, that's good... We thought you might've been surrounded by bad guys!

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I apologize, I didn't mean to alarm you. Fortunately, there are no more Treasure Hoarders in the area. It seems this matter has finally come to an end.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Great! The case of the stolen fireworks is finally solved, good thing we were able to get to the bottom of it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Otherwise, those beautiful fireworks would have gone to waste and the whole show would be ruined.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's right.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: By the way, Keqing, you're the one in charge of the fireworks show, which means you know the best viewing spot, right?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Yes, of course. The best view should be from the Jade Chamber.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Don't worry, I haven't forgotten my promise. But first, I have to drop by the Ministry of Civil Affairs and close this case.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Leave the rest of this to me, you've already been a great help. Why don't you go for a walk around the city and I'll meet you when I am done?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay... But we'll be waiting for you!

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Yes, I'll be there.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Keqing leaves...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* Keqing really is super busy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "I'll meet you when I am done." How many times have we heard that already?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now Paimon gets why Lady Ningguang is so worried about Keqing. If she keeps working like this, she really will miss the Lantern Rite.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Hmm, let's go find Zhongli.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh yeah, we said we would meet him! And we've even collected a few opinions about taking a rest from work.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Zhongli said he'd wait for us at Third-Round Knockout. Let's go find him!

choices.text: Wait, where are the Treasure Hoarders?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, is that who Paimon thinks it is...

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Yes, you are quite right, I shall take your wise words to heart, sir. They will certainly be most helpful in my next performance.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: You are welcome, Ms. Yun. Your willingness to hear suggestions is indeed impressive. It's no wonder your opera performance has only been getting better.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: No, I'm afraid that's not always the case. Though I am still young, I can be quite arrogant at times. I do not always accept advice so readily, but your wisdom has spoken to me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Zhongli! We're back!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Ah, you've returned.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Hmm? You are also acquaintances?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes, we sure are!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We've met on a couple of occasions.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Not everyone gets the privilege of meeting someone so knowledgeable and discreet as Mr. Zhongli.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: You are indeed well-connected, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: I am flattered, Ms. Yun. It is an honor for an ordinary person like myself to have met the Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, did he really just say that...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (I wouldn't dare reveal his true identity.)

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: I'm sure you must have matters to discuss. I have an appointment with Xinyan, so if you'll excuse me, I'll take my leave.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Very well. Goodbye, Ms. Yun.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: See you around, Yun Jin!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: So, tell me, what have you learned from your trip?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We asked around, and...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Zhongli about everyone's views on work-life balance...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Hmm, I see. Well, Traveler, what do you make of all their opinions?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think we can weave them into a story.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! Paimon already started creating her own story on the way here. The goal is to convince Keqing to rest more with just a simple story, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If that's the case, then Paimon thinks we can use food as our theme!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Think about it, who doesn't like delicious food? And when it comes to eating, everyone has an opinion. It's the perfect angle for our story!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, Paimon knows just what to write!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's say there's a chef in Liyue who's very talented at cooking.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He opens a massive restaurant in Liyue Harbor, and lots of customers come every day, so he's always super busy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then, well... hmm... How should the story go from there?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: His food starts getting worse and worse?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, that's good! But wait, didn't we say he's really good at cooking? That wouldn't make sense...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's up to you, it's your story!

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: There's no need to jump to the conclusion. Why don't you elaborate more on the chef?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: More about the chef... You mean both good and bad things?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Yes. To gain one's empathy, there must be familiarity. I would like to understand this chef character of ours a little deeper.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hmm, Paimon didn't think this far... Why don't you take it from here, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Since you've spoken with others familiar with Keqing, why don't we integrate their thoughts into your story? That will allow it to become all the more convincing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay! Let Paimon think... What did Cloud Retainer say?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "As one sows, so do they reap, and the joy of reaping is what one yearns for."

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: That was quite poetic, Paimon. Bravo.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe! Oh! Now Paimon remembers! Cloud Retainer said that if she spends all her efforts working on a machine with no time to test the outcome...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then she'd be like a chef who doesn't get to try their own food. Problems are bound to pop up.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Yes, it is most unwise to put the cart before the horse.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-huh, that's exactly what she said! So let's make that happen to the chef in the story... He's great at cooking, but he can't enjoy his own food.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Hmm, but there must be a reason why he doesn't partake in the delicacies he makes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right, it's because he's super busy! He receives the customers, he takes the orders, and he does all the cooking himself...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, that should keep him busy enough. He's so busy every day that he doesn't even have time to take a break, which obviously also means he doesn't have time to eat.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That sounds a bit extreme...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, it's just a story! Besides, it's supposed to leave a powerful impression, kinda like fireworks!

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Yes, the chef is unwilling to delegate tasks to others. He's overconfident about his own cooking abilities, and tries to accomplish everything on his own.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon already kinda feels sorry for him.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: "Many hands make light work!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, right! That's what the chef doesn't understand!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And there's another saying... erm... What was it, again?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh yeah, "A rested worker is an efficient worker!" That's what Yanfei said.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So the chef gets busier and busier. To the point where he can't stand up straight anymore and has big dark circles under his eyes. The customers tell him to take a few days off to get some rest, but the chef won't listen.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: His judgment is clouded by the chores before him. He is oblivious to mountains in the distance, the bigger picture.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eventually, the chef falls ill and his cooking becomes far worse than when he started. The customers can't convince him to rest and they don't like his cooking anymore, so they stop coming to his restaurant.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Rest is always of great importance. Although we may come across various difficulties in our lives, pushing ourselves is never a good modus operandi.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: The story is simple without embellishment, yet deeply meaningful. If our listener is sensible, then she should quickly grasp the meaning contained within.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're saying... Paimon made a good story!?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Sincerity can allow one to see clearly, and earnest advice can provide sound direction. The story is indeed good.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: The Yuheng is an adroit leader. I am certain she will understand the message you are trying to convey.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? Score one for Paimon!

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Given that the case involving the Treasure Hoarders has come to an end, she is inevitably tired. Now will be the ideal moment to speak with her.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: If all goes well, I think your story will be a success.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hear that? Zhongli says Paimon's story has what it takes! If anyone knows a good story, he does!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Quick, let's go find Keqing!

choices.text: The consequences of not getting enough rest are pretty serious.

talks.objective: Go to the Ministry of Civil Affairs and find Keqing

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: The matter has finally come to an end, but we mustn't lower our guard. Increase patrols around Qingce Village and coordinate our people at other fireworks locations to prevent any further theft.

dialogues.speaker: Jingcheng
dialogues.text: Yes, Lady Keqing.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: And by the way, the Ministry has requested the Millelith to increase security along travel routes. How is that proceeding?

dialogues.speaker: Jingcheng
dialogues.text: It's all been taken care of. However, due to various reasons, there are still some blind spots in the city.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Have we drafted a new patrol map? Please give me a copy and I'll look it over when I have time.

dialogues.speaker: Jingcheng
dialogues.text: Understood! The patrol map is still being drafted, but it will be ready soon.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Okay. Also, I...

dialogues.speaker: Jingcheng
dialogues.text: Oh, excuse me, Lady Keqing... Your friends are here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hi Keqing, still working? Aren't we going to see the fireworks?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Oh, yes, but I thought we'd meet at the Jade Chamber. Why have you come here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You told us to walk and have a look around.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, we walked around the city just like you told us to, it's very nice. But, it would be even nicer if you could join us! Do you still have work to do?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: It's nothing urgent, really, just some trivial matters. But I wish to get it done as soon as possible...

dialogues.speaker: Jingcheng
dialogues.text: You can leave it to us, Lady Keqing. You've been working hard for a long time, so you should get some rest. If I'm not mistaken, the Traveler is here to remind you to take a break.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And we have something to tell you, Keqing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right! Something so important that we must speak with you personally, right now!

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Oh, really? In that case... Jingcheng, I'll let you take charge, thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Jingcheng
dialogues.text: Understood, I'll handle things from here.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Traveler and Paimon, let's go to the Jade Chamber. The view there is nicer and it's much more private, perfect for talking.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Well, here we are.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: What was it you wanted to talk about?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We have a story to tell you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! We want to tell you a story from this beautiful view. Whaddya say?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Alright, I'm listening.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, it turns out we just heard some big news in Teyvat! A very talented chef is in trouble!

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Oh? Is the chef from Liyue? From Liuli Pavilion or Xinyue Kiosk, perhaps?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, no. Uh, the chef is from... Mondstadt! Yeah, and he's really, really good!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He had a restaurant right next to the city gate. He was super efficient and his cooking was really delicious, so his restaurant had been getting more and more popular.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In fact, he became so busy that the worker from the florist next door asked him, "Sir, why don't you find someone to help you in the restaurant?"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But the chef brushed the idea aside, saying that he's the only one that can turn top-quality ingredients into world-class dishes, no one could help him.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Hmm. Well, confidence is an essential trait for a good chef. He must be an excellent cook.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's what everyone was saying... But surprisingly, after just six months, no one would dine in his restaurant anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Oh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shocking, right? Do you have any guess why?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Hmm. Maybe the chef had fallen ill, or...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Wrong answer! You tell her, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Because he was too stubborn.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ding ding ding! Yep, it's because the chef was too stubborn!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He would keep himself busy every day, and try to make the most delicious dishes for all his guests. But, he forgot that he's only human and needs time to eat and rest.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He was so busy that he didn't even have time to eat and couldn't even taste his own cooking.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He was unwilling to seek help even when he's tired, because he thought he's the only one capable of cooking the best dishes.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eventually, the people around him felt like they couldn't help him anyway, so they just left. And because he had forgotten the original taste of his dishes, he was no longer a good chef.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In the end, his restaurant had no choice but to close for good.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Oh...

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: I see. He's overly confident, which disappoints the people around him, and he's so impatient that he ends up losing sight of his original purpose.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: *sigh*...

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: So, that's the whole story?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, umm... Yep, that's the whole thing.

choices.text: Sorry, it's not a very good story.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Didn't you just say that Paimon made a great story!?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Hmm? Did you come up with that story?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! N—No, we just, uh...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Heh...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Hmm, how should I describe it... The story is very simple, and I suppose the ending isn't really surprising.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Huh!?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Think before you act and don't overexert yourself. Of course, I understand these concepts in theory, but when tasks come to me personally, it is easy to lose sight of the bigger picture.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's as if "your judgment is clouded," right?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Yes. Up in the mountains, we can see the mist in the clouds. Out in the ocean, we can see fog on the sea. That's why from time to time, we need to examine where we are, remove the fog, and feel our heart.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, how do you feel now, Keqing?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: How do I feel?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Hmm...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Deep down inside, I wish I could slow down time. That way, I could finally take the opportunity to walk around the city, see the people I wish to see, and watch the fireworks.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Thinking back, I used to be even more impatient. My colleagues would resign after just three months of working with me.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: You're completely right. It's important to know your boundaries.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: But, I am getting better! You can tell, can't you?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: And I did make a promise with you, didn't I?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: We agreed to enjoy the fireworks show together this year. So...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Happy Lantern Rite, Traveler and Paimon, I'm very happy to be here and enjoy this moment together with you.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I've poured all my best effort into this fireworks show. And now that we're here, I sincerely hope you will enjoy it.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I feel very fortunate to be right here, enjoying the fireworks, and enjoying the view of Liyue Harbor.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Happy Lantern Rite, Keqing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Happy Lantern Rite!

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Happy Lantern Rite. And... thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Pengyi
dialogues.text: A burst of fireworks... Could it be the Treasure Hoarders? Oh Lady Keqing, please stay safe! It's up to you to find out what's happening, Traveler. Good luck!

dialogues.speaker: Jingcheng
dialogues.text: Hmph, your hoarding days are over! How dare you cause trouble during Lantern Rite. You'll get what you deserve once we hand you over to the Ministry of Civil Affairs!

dialogues.speaker: Xingxiu
dialogues.text: *sigh* I guess we're done for...

dialogues.speaker: Junming
dialogues.text: How did the Millelith find us so fast?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: I wish you luck, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Jingcheng
dialogues.text: Just leave it all to me.
